title: Adding Developer Solution to 216 Well Cartridge Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Load labware definitions
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package containing the custom labware definitions for the Nest 1‑Well Reservoir 195 mL and the Invoy 216‑Well Cartridge Plate, then upload these definitions into the Opentrons OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the Invoy 216‑Well Cartridge Plate in slots 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11; place the Opentrons 96 Tip Rack 300 µL in slot 6; place the Nest 1‑Well Reservoir 195 mL in slot 9.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑App, calibrate the cartridge plate, tip rack, and the Opentrons P300 single‑channel pipette according to the standard calibration procedure.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the protocol customizations field, set the Number of Samples, Dispense Height Above Cartridge (mm), Dispense Volume (µL) per cartridge, and Dispense Flow Rate (µL/sec) for aspiration and dispense.

steps.title: Transfer developer solution
steps.instruction: Aspirate developer solution from the Nest 195 mL reservoir (aspirate extra volume to ensure each cartridge receives enough liquid) and distribute it to the 216‑Well Cartridge Plate column‑wise using the P300 pipette.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the specified volume of developer solution from the reservoir.
Dispense the solution into cartridges in chunks of three per aspiration, moving down the plate by column.
After each chunk, include a pause (delay) to accommodate the viscous liquid and perform a blow‑out to ensure complete delivery.
Repeat the aspirate‑dispense‑delay‑blow‑out cycle until all cartridges have received the specified dispense volume at the defined height.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: In the OT‑App, upload the completed protocol and press “Run” to execute the developer solution transfer.
